Regression coefficients of the one-step latent class regression

coeftable.Rd

Regression coefficients of the one-step latent class regression

Usage

coeftable(object, ref = NULL)

Arguments

object

A latentmix model fitted with covariates (Mplus c ON x), or an LTA (with or without covariates; also from lta3step()).

ref

For an LTA, the reference class of the logits (default K).

Value

A data frame with class, term, estimate (multinomial logit against the reference class), se (robust), z, p and oddsratio. For an LTA: the initial-class and transition rows of parameters() (Mplus parameterisation, with parameter, kind, wave, class, from) and oddsratio.

See also

lca(), r3step(), lm_table() (what = "regression")

Examples

data(aces)
# \donttest{
# one-step model: does parental education predict the ACE class? (class 1 = reference)
m <- lca(aces, starts_with("ace_"), K = 4, covariates = c(female, low_parent_edu), ref = 1)
#> Starting Julia ...
coeftable(m)   # positive low_parent_edu coefficients: more adversity with low education
#>   class           term    estimate        se           z            p oddsratio
#> 1     2    (Intercept) -1.42694546 0.1634866  -8.7282128 2.587284e-18 0.2400410
#> 2     2         female  0.07231937 0.1843463   0.3923018 6.948352e-01 1.0749986
#> 3     2 low_parent_edu  0.60843906 0.1810902   3.3598666 7.798010e-04 1.8375608
#> 4     3    (Intercept) -1.51021957 0.2233033  -6.7630865 1.350826e-11 0.2208615
#> 5     3         female -0.31992196 0.2054851  -1.5569108 1.194917e-01 0.7262057
#> 6     3 low_parent_edu  0.78124786 0.2049826   3.8112878 1.382447e-04 2.1841961
#> 7     4    (Intercept) -2.12684232 0.2100751 -10.1242016 4.314858e-24 0.1192131
#> 8     4         female  0.10667717 0.2354634   0.4530520 6.505113e-01 1.1125750
